name: ModelVariant113_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant113_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (four pulsing horizontal 3x3 grids scroll vertically through the other slot's position, a pulsing burst quad flashes there on even frames and sparks fly from its centre to random points on a sphere, fading as they travel); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the grids and sparks and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the interval, 4 while the effect runs, 1 once near the end and 2 after that; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-130 and 260 images build it from the same source with the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
